vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: salesforce-api
Version: 1.0.3

The skill bundle is designed for Salesforce API integration via the Maton platform. All code examples and instructions in SKILL.md consistently direct network requests to `gateway.maton.ai` and `ctrl.maton.ai` using a `MATON_API_KEY` from environment variables. There is no evidence of data exfiltration to unauthorized endpoints, malicious command execution (e.g., `curl|bash`), persistence mechanisms, obfuscation, or prompt injection attempts against the AI agent to perform actions outside the stated purpose. The skill's functionality is clearly defined and aligns with its description.

llm.summary: The skill appears to implement Salesforce access via the Maton API gateway (which is coherent), but the skill manifest omits the required MATON_API_KEY credential and source/homepage info, and model-invocation plus missing declared env vars create a risky mismatch.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md describes Salesforce REST API operations (SOQL queries, sObject CRUD, composite requests) and all runtime examples target a Maton gateway (gateway.maton.ai / ctrl.maton.ai). Using a gateway + managed OAuth is a coherent implementation for a Salesforce integration.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions explicitly require reading an environment variable MATON_API_KEY (examples use os.environ['MATON_API_KEY']) and direct network calls to gateway.maton.ai and ctrl.maton.ai. The instructions do not attempt to read unrelated files, but they do access an environment secret that is not declared in the registry metadata, creating an unexpected scope requirement.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec or code files, so nothing is written to disk and there are no package downloads. That minimizes install-time risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md requires MATON_API_KEY (a bearer token that grants gateway access to Salesforce connections), but the registry metadata lists no required env vars or primary credential. Requesting a single API key is proportionate for the described gateway usage — however the manifest omission is a mismatch and hides the fact that a secret is needed and that it grants access to user Salesforce data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not set always:true (good), but disableModelInvocation is also not set (defaults to model-invocable). Combined with the undeclared MATON_API_KEY, this means the agent could potentially call the gateway autonomously and use any MATON_API_KEY present in the environment without the user being aware.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, note that the SKILL.md explicitly requires a MATON_API_KEY and network access to maton.ai services, but the registry metadata does not declare that credential or provide a source/homepage — this is a mismatch you should resolve. Ask the publisher to (1) declare MATON_API_KEY as the primaryEnv in the manifest, (2) provide a source URL and homepage and confirm who operates maton.ai, and (3) consider setting disableModelInvocation:true if you do not want the model to call Salesforce autonomously. Only provide your Maton API key if you trust the Maton service and understand that their gateway will be able to access your Salesforce data via managed OAuth. If you need a tighter control path, prefer an integration whose manifest clearly lists required credentials and provenance (or use your own api-gateway integration).
